description: Source code for ewah_bitmap implementation, including functions for bitmap manipulation, compression, iteration, and set operations.

methods.name: min_size
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two size_t values.

methods.name: max_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two size_t values.

methods.name: buffer_grow
methods.description: Grows the buffer of ewah_bitmap to accommodate new_size.

methods.name: buffer_push
methods.description: Pushes a value into the buffer of ewah_bitmap.

methods.name: buffer_push_rlw
methods.description: Pushes a run length word into the buffer.

methods.name: add_empty_words
methods.description: Adds empty (all zero or all one) words to the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_add_empty_words
methods.description: Adds empty words with specified value to the bitmap.

methods.name: add_literal
methods.description: Adds a literal word to the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_add_dirty_words
methods.description: Adds dirty (non-zero/non-all-one) words, possibly negated.

methods.name: add_empty_word
methods.description: Adds a single empty word with specified value.

methods.name: ewah_add
methods.description: Adds a word to the bitmap, handling zero, all-one, or literal.

methods.name: ewah_set
methods.description: Sets a specific bit in the bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_each_bit
methods.description: Iterates over each bit, calling a callback.

methods.name: ewah_clear
methods.description: Clears the bitmap without freeing memory.

methods.name: ewah_new
methods.description: Creates a new ewah_bitmap instance.

methods.name: ewah_free
methods.description: Frees an ewah_bitmap instance.

methods.name: read_new_rlw
methods.description: Reads the next run length word for iteration.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next word.

methods.name: ewah_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for a bitmap.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes an OR iterator over multiple bitmaps.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_next
methods.description: Gets the next OR result from multiple iterators.

methods.name: ewah_or_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources for OR iterator.

methods.name: ewah_xor
methods.description: Performs XOR operation on two bitmaps, storing result in output.

methods.name: ewah_pool_new
methods.description: Allocates a new bitmap from the pool or creates a new one.

methods.name: ewah_pool_free
methods.description: Returns a bitmap to the pool or frees it.

methods.name: ewah_checksum
methods.description: Computes a checksum of the bitmap.
